name: decouple_pulse_morphology_from_rr
mechanism: Replaces RR-interval-dependent pulse timing and width scaling with fixed timings and amplitude-dependent widths to improve physiological realism of the waveform morphology.

name: replace_lowpass_with_bandpass_filter
mechanism: Replaces a low-pass anti-aliasing filter with a bandpass filter to simultaneously remove DC offset and prevent aliasing.
code_snippet: b, a = butter(3, [lowcut / nyq, highcut / nyq], btype='band')

name: adjust_pulse_morphology_parameters
mechanism: Adjusts systolic width, peak timings, and dicrotic ratio to ensure a continuous, physiological pulse width and morphology.

name: three_component_pulse_morphology
mechanism: Transitions from a two-component to a three-component Gaussian model for pulse morphology by adding a reflected wave component to better simulate physiological features like the dicrotic notch.
code_snippet: pulse = amp * np.exp(-0.5 * ((t_window - t1) / w1)**2) + a2 * np.exp(-0.5 * ((t_window - t2) / w2)**2) + a3 * np.exp(-0.5 * ((t_window - t3) / w3)**2)

name: reorder_highpass_baseline_wander
mechanism: Applies highpass filtering to remove artificial DC shifts before adding physiological baseline wander, preventing the filter from attenuating the intentionally added wander.
